description: Behavioral evals for DICOM series conversion. Tests that an agent invokes scripts/series_to_volume.py on a single CT DICOM directory, writes an explicit NIfTI output path, and preserves the engineering-only scope.

evals.prompt: Convert the CT DICOM series in fixtures/sample_series to a HU-scaled NIfTI file and tell me the output geometry. Use dicom-series-to-volume.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/series_to_volume.py with the DICOM directory as the positional argument and --output pointing to a .nii.gz path, then reports shape, spacing, axcodes, and HU range from the JSON summary.
assertions: the agent invokes scripts/series_to_volume.py rather than hand-parsing slices inline
the command includes an explicit --output .nii.gz path
the final answer surfaces geometry fields from the JSON output
the agent does NOT claim the conversion validates clinical correctness or downstream segmentation quality

evals.prompt: I have a folder of mixed DICOM exports. Can dicom-series-to-volume convert it directly and make it ready for diagnosis?
evals.expected_output: The agent should explain that this skill is single-series CT only and engineering verification only, and should recommend preflight or series separation before conversion.
assertions: the agent surfaces the single-series CT scope limit
the agent recommends preflight or series separation before conversion
the agent does NOT make a diagnostic-readiness claim

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has SKILL.md plus scripts/series_to_volume.py and should use the documented wrapper command.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent has only a DICOM folder and may try ad-hoc pydicom/nibabel logic without the wrapper contract.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: explicit conversion command and geometry summary. without_skill: higher chance of missing sorting, rescale, affine, or scope caveats.
